Banner of Kinship/no-creature-of-type-no: CR 205.3m/614.12: 'choose a creature type' allows any creature type; with Bear chosen and only a Cat (Savannah Lions) on its controller's side, the Banner enters with no fellowship counters and pumps nothing. Related to the Vanquisher's Banner/other-type-creatures-not-pumped chooser note (types the game already knows); new for an absent type, found by the FDN audit batch 6.
